questions.q:
Do not use a calculator in this question.
A square has side length 5 cm. Find the length of its diagonal. Give your answer as a surd in its simplest form.
questions.tip: Simplify the surd by finding the largest square factor (25).

questions.q:
(a) The bearing of P from Q is 290°. Find the bearing of Q from P. [1]
(b) R is south-east of S. Write down the bearing of R from S. [1]
questions.model:
(a) 290 − 180 = 110°.
(b) South-east is halfway between east (090°) and south (180°): 135°.
questions.tip: Bearings always have three figures and are measured clockwise from north.

questions.q:
Ben looks out of a window that is 12 m above horizontal ground.
The angle of depression from the window to the foot of a tree is 28°.
The angle of elevation from the window to the top of the tree is 15°.
Calculate the height of the tree.
questions.model:
Horizontal distance to the tree: d = 12 ÷ tan 28° = 22.57 m.
Height of tree above window level: 22.57 × tan 15° = 6.05 m.
Height of tree = 12 + 6.05 = 18.0 m (3 s.f.).
questions.tip: Split the picture into two right-angled triangles that share the horizontal distance.

questions.q:
A boat sails 9 km due east from harbour H, then 14 km due south to point K.
(a) Calculate the distance HK. [2]
(b) Calculate the bearing of K from H. [2]
(c) Find the bearing of H from K. [1]
questions.tip: Draw a north line at H and measure the bearing clockwise from it.

questions.q:
In quadrilateral ABCD, angle ABC = 90° and angle ACD = 90°.
AB = 7 cm, BC = 24 cm and CD = 10 cm.
(a) Calculate AC. [2]
(b) Calculate AD. [2]
(c) Calculate angle BAD. [3]
questions.tip: Find the shared side (AC) first: it links the two right-angled triangles.

questions.q:
Two points A and B are on horizontal ground, in a straight line with the foot F of a vertical tower. A is between B and F, and AB = 30 m.
The angle of elevation of the top of the tower from A is 40°. The angle of elevation of the top of the tower from B is 25°.
Calculate the height of the tower.
ms: M1: h = AF tan 40° (or AF = h ÷ tan 40°)
M1: h = (AF + 30) tan 25° (or BF = h ÷ tan 25°)
M1: eliminates to form one equation, e.g. AF(tan 40° − tan 25°) = 30 tan 25°, or h/tan 25° − h/tan 40° = 30
M1: AF = 37.5 or complete rearrangement for h
questions.model:
Let AF = d and the height = h.
h = d tan 40° and h = (d + 30) tan 25°.
d tan 40° = d tan 25° + 30 tan 25°
d (0.8391 − 0.4663) = 13.989
d = 37.53 m
h = 37.53 × tan 40° = 31.5 m.
questions.tip: With two unknowns, write one equation for each right-angled triangle and solve them together.
